name: MacBase: Black Friday Mac App Deals
cost_note: 'List your Mac apps for free'; no cut of sales. Featured placement is paid per week or month.
how_to_submit: Sign in (on 19 Nov 2026 new accounts went through X, GitHub or Google; the sign-in page showed no provider buttons to a fetcher on 20 Nov), submit the app at https://macbase.app/submit (paste the Mac App Store link and it drafts the listing), then after approval add the deal in the dashboard under deals/black-friday: an offer line, an optional code, an optional link, first and last day.
rules: Listings are reviewed within a day.
Screenshots should show the app's own windows at 16:10.
The 2026 deal window runs from 19 Nov 2026 to 4 Jan 2027.
The member-deal block needs a code. A do-follow link needs their badge on your site; that is a request, not a condition of listing.
status_note: 93 deals on 22 Nov 2026 (69 on 20 Nov). The page calls them deals 'straight from their makers' and asks developers to 'Add your app's deal'.
recommended_for: Mac apps listed by their makers; needs a sign-in, so the text is handed over
